fine_lines.title: Waffle on vs bang on about
fine_lines.explanation_ar: waffle on تعني أن تتكلم كثيراً بلا فائدة ولا معنى واضح. bang on about something تعني أن تتكلم عن الموضوع نفسه مراراً وتكراراً بطريقة مزعجة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Waffle on' = talk a lot without saying anything useful. 'Bang on about something' = keep talking about the same subject again and again, annoyingly.

examples.sentence: He didn't know the answer, so he just waffled on.
She keeps banging on about her new car.

fine_lines.title: Brake vs break
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان تُنطقان بالطريقة نفسها. brake = فرامل أو يضغط الفرامل. break = يكسر أو استراحة. التعبير هو put the brakes on.
fine_lines.explanation_en: These words sound the same. Brake = the part that stops a car, or to use it. Break = to damage into pieces, or a rest. The idiom is 'put the brakes on'.

examples.sentence: We need to put the brakes on our spending.

expressions.meaning_en: the process of helping new staff learn about their job and company
expressions.example: Onboarding takes two weeks and includes computer training.

expressions.meaning_en: the person who tried to make others look silly now looks silly
expressions.example: You said my plan would fail, but it worked - the joke's on you.

expressions.meaning_en: to talk for a long time without saying anything important
expressions.example: Please don't waffle on in your presentation - keep it short.

expressions.meaning_en: to slow down or stop an activity or plan
expressions.example: We've put the brakes on our travel plans until next year.

expressions.meaning_en: when someone reads your message but doesn't reply
expressions.example: I asked a simple question and was left on read for two days.

expressions.meaning_en: to talk about something again and again in an annoying way
expressions.example: My uncle always bangs on about how cheap things were in the past.

expressions.meaning_ar: يعمل بآخر ما تبقى من طاقته
expressions.meaning_en: continuing even though you have almost no energy left
expressions.example: After three night shifts, I'm running on fumes.

expressions.meaning_en: an idea or problem to think about carefully
expressions.example: Your suggestion gives us something to chew on.

grammar.title: Phrasal verbs with 'on' meaning 'continue'
grammar.explanation_ar: في بعض الأفعال المركبة تعني on الاستمرار: waffle on (يستمر في الثرثرة)، bang on (يستمر في الكلام عن الشيء نفسه)، go on (يستمر). وفي تعابير أخرى تعني on 'باستخدام' أو 'حول': running on fumes، chew on.
grammar.explanation_en: In some phrasal verbs 'on' means 'continue': waffle on, bang on, go on. In other expressions it means 'using' or 'about': running on fumes, chew on something.
examples: He waffled on for an hour.
